ES Friday's low not given as a number (5984.5-5987.5 was 'widened ... to capture Friday's low') -> es1 gated FRI_LOW; NQ Friday's low given as 21722 -> nq3 gated on the number; Friday's high not given for NQ -> nq2 gated FRI_HIGH, nq1 last target FRI_HIGH. es1 states no target: used 6004-6008 (the retest level named in its paragraph; no Trading Higher section exists). nq2 extended 'bearish engulfing' levels 680-694 / 630-653 left out of tgt (stated as a possibility, not a target). trades.name: Hold/LBAF of 21763-21771
trades.quote: Long NQ on a hold or (better) LBAF of 763-771. As long as 785 reclaims I generally expect to see 846 and then 874-888 come into play. I’ll get cautious if 785 rejects from below and take profit or be prepared to flatten but I’m targeting 803-810, 846, and Friday’s high. I can rate this a B+. It would be rated higher if range was a bit better and I didn’t have minor concerns about 785.
trades.stop_hint: I’ll get cautious if 785 rejects from below and take profit or be prepared to flatten

trades.name: LAAF of Friday's high
trades.quote: Short NQ on a look above and fail of Friday’s high. If 846 holds from above, I’ll get cautious and consider profit takes and be prepared to flatten at breakeven. Otherwise, I’m targeting 803-810, 785, 763-771 and through there a bearish engulfing day becomes possible. I would make no assumptions about a bearish engulfing day given the strength of the recent trend, so I’ll plan to take profits judiciously. I’ll rate this as a B+ as well. It gets a bit of a downgrade because of the prevailing bullish trend but a bit of an upgrade given the (perhaps narrow) possibility that it triggers a bearish engulfing day down to 680-694 and possibly 630-653.
trades.stop_hint: If 846 holds from above, I’ll get cautious and consider profit takes and be prepared to flatten at breakeven.

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low
trades.quote: Long ES on a LBAF of Friday’s low as this would be yet another hold of the prior 3-week balance high and we still have unfilled overnight single prints below Friday’s low. They were reactive twice on NQ Friday and once on ES. Perhaps they hold a second test for ES. I’ll rate this a B+ as well and the only reason it isn’t higher is because 6004-6008 could end up being heavy from below on a retest.
trades.stop_hint: 6004-6008 could end up being heavy from below on a retest
